messages.subject: Re: object 'output' not found in sumstats()
messages.body_plain:
Hi Shams,

So your GWASes, are either of continuous traits (i.e. use OLS = T for those traits ), ofr of case control traits if those are run using logistic regression so no flag needed unless these are run using OLS regression (which for example Ben Neale's lab does to run 2000 GWASes rapidly), in which case linprob=T is appropriate.

The names of your traits sugest the corect settings for OLS may be:

OLS = c(F,F,F,T,T,T)

IF you have got thse sumstats from the Neale lab website, or you ran linear regression for the GWAS of dichotomous traits yourself you also need to set:

linprob =c(T,T,T,F,F,F)

Then finally you need to set the proportion of cases using the prop= argument for the case control traits.

Let me know if this solves the issue!

Best,
Michel

> Thanks,
>
> Shams
